integrity: The general staircase result is analytic. The finite example is independently replayable from a standalone exact-rational dynamic program; numerical root finding only locates analytically isolated scalar boundaries.
scientific_limitations: The general theorem is for simple i.i.d. Bernoulli hypotheses and the normalized power-likelihood family.
The exact optimizer interval is specific to the displayed design and concerns first-passage rejection by horizon 30.
No claim is made about optimality over all e-variables, all sequential tests, or nonlattice observations.
title: Lattice plateaus in horizon-optimal flattened Bernoulli e-tests
